observations.behavior: Adds a duplicate-check before creating a shortcut in the backend, returning the existing record if a matching shortcut already exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents database row duplication when a user stars the same item twice, preserving the existing record instead of creating a new one.

observations.behavior: Adds a duplicate-check in the frontend state update, returning the current shortcut list without adding the response if an ID already exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents the UI from displaying the same shortcut twice in the starred list after an API response that already contains the item.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that starring the same item twice results in only one database record and returns the same ID.
